authoring: tools/check.cjs --write renders every PNG from tools/kit.js renderPlan(); 4x is the 1x grid scaled by 4, nearest neighbour. rgbaSha256 is the SHA-256 of the pixels as straight RGBA bytes, row-major, empty pixels 0,0,0,0; pngSha256 the file's as shipped (another PNG encoder writes other bytes for the same pixels; tools/check.cjs holds the pixels and only notes a pngSha256 that differs).

render.sky: none (the afternoon key the rig is authored at)

idle8.cell: render({ build, clip: "idle", frame: 0, dir }) for dir 0..7 (N, NE, E, SE, S, SW, W, NW), left to right

walkS.cell: render({ build, clip: "walk", frame, dir: 4 }) for frame 0..7 (110 ms each)

blink.cell: render({ build, clip: "idle", frame: 0, dir, face: { eyes: BLINK.frames[k], brows, mouth } }): rows dir 2..6 (E, SE, S, SW, W, the facings with an eye), columns k = 0..3 (half, shut, shut, half; 40 ms each, the faceClips.blink track); brows and mouth are idle f0's

look.cell: render({ build, clip: "idle", frame: 0, dir: 4, look: { yaw, pitch }, face }): row 0 the head turned to each limit in the order of checkHelpers.LIMITS (yaw, pitch: -60 0, 60 0, 0 -15, 0 20, -60 20, 60 20, -60 -15, 60 -15), eyes as idle f0 has them; row 1 lookAt(S, target) with the default share (LOOK.headShare 0.7) for targets 2 m from the head point at bearings -50, -30, -15, 0, 15, 30, 50 deg level, and 0 deg 0.35 m down, eyes.open replaced by lookAt's eyes; each image's turns lists the angles used

cast.cell: every CAST build in CAST order, ten to a row, each at S (dir 4) then SE (dir 3), idle f0, x2
